name: graceful_graph_k3_p10__v11_nh
prompt:
Find a graceful labeling for the graph G_{3,10}: 10 disjoint K_3 cliques (numbered 0 through 9), where each pair of consecutive cliques (g, g+1) is connected by 3 edges that link vertex i of clique g to vertex i of clique g+1 for each i in 0..2. The graph has 30 vertices and 57 edges in total.

A graceful labeling assigns each vertex a unique label from 0 to 57 such that all edge labels |label(u) - label(v)| are distinct.

Return a list of 30 integers giving the vertex labels, ordered by clique then vertex within clique (so the i-th block of 3 consecutive entries gives the labels for clique i), or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such labeling exists.
